title: Ability to specify other desktops to also display windows on, not just moving them there (as in the titlebar context menu)
line: The task manager's right-click menu now lets you put a window on several desktops with checkboxes, like the window title bar menu.
explanation: The task context menu's desktop submenu put every desktop and All Desktops in one exclusive action group, and each item asked for exactly that one desktop, so a window could only be moved, never shown on several desktops. KWin's window menu (Alt+F3) has checkboxes that add or remove the window from each desktop plus separate "Move to" items. The submenu now mirrors KWin's: it is called Desktops, the desktops and All Desktops are independent checkboxes that toggle the window on that desktop (unchecking All Desktops leaves it on the current one, unchecking its last desktop puts it on all, as in KWin), and "Move to <desktop>" items keep the old one-desktop move.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: let windows be on several desktops from the menu

The task context menu could only move a window to one desktop, unlike
KWin's window menu. Desktops are now checkboxes that add or remove the
window like there, followed by "Move to" items for a single desktop.

BUG: 491306
